title: Creamy Brazilian Stew
description: A rich, comforting stew that combines the flavors of Brazil with the creaminess of velvety sauce. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, water, and browned sausage back to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the velvety sauce mix and nourishing stew seasoning. Return the chicken to the pot and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Serve hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or crusty bread, if desired.
